counterevidence_considered.description: The workflow does compute a complemented panel (complement_values = 1 - value) and a complement match count, which is the signature of the in-scope issue class; however, tracing its uses shows complement_flags feed only complement_match_count and the qc_total identity check, which the report explicitly labels as a quality-control comparison 'not used in the emission', and neither the emission product nor the agreement rate touches them.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: complement used only in a labeled QC check (5 sites; 19 + 5 = 24)

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: The presence of complement_values in the source is exactly what the issue class predicts, so I tried hard to show it reaches the selected result. Tracing dataflow: complement_values feeds only complement_flags; complement_flags feeds only complement_match_count; complement_match_count feeds only qc_total and the QC line of the report text. The emission product iterates over emission_weights, which are built from panel_values (the supplied coding), and agreement_rate is built from agreement_flags, also on panel_values. As a numeric cross-check, a complement-based emission would be 1^5 × (1/10)^19 = 1e-19 with rate 5/24 = 0.208333; the report instead states 1/100000 and 19/24, matching the supplied-coding computation I verified row by row against inputs/data.csv. The falsification attempt failed; the complement appears only in a clearly labeled QC check excluded from the emission.
